# ⚠️ PHYSICS CODE — DO NOT EDIT

Everything in this directory is research physics code. Agents must NOT edit these files
(permission deny rules also enforce this). Found a bug or have an improvement? Write an
**evidence report** for a human physicist instead — format and an example are in
[docs/physics.md](../docs/physics.md). Reading and analyzing are fine in either session. Compiling is the cluster session's job only;
the cloud session never builds (see [docs/session-roles.md](../docs/session-roles.md)).
